scripts.title: Brazilian Mechanics Hub By: Snow
scripts.author: Uriel_Xits
scripts.summary: Speed Hack🇧🇷🇧🇷 Second Hub, but inspired by my other script, VENENO HUB🩸. . .
scripts.code:
--========================================================
-- 🍀 BRAZILIAN MECHANICS - MOTOR VENENO V5
-- SEM PLATAFORMA / SEM KEY
-- VELOCIDADE CONFIGURÁVEL: ATÉ 3500 KM/H
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local PG = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local LIMITE_VELOCIDADE = 3500
local DIVISOR_VELOCIMETRO = 3.93951612903

--========================================================
-- LIMPEZA
--========================================================
for _, nome in ipairs({"BrasilIntro", "BrasilGui"}) do
    local antigo = PG:FindFirstChild(nome)
    if antigo then antigo:Destroy() end
end

--========================================================
-- INTRO (TREVO + CARREGAMENTO ANIMADO)
--========================================================
local Intro = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Intro.Name = "BrasilIntro"
Intro.IgnoreGuiInset = true
Intro.ResetOnSpawn = false
Intro.DisplayOrder = 999
Intro.Parent = PG

local Fundo = Instance.new("Frame")
Fundo.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
Fundo.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10,12,10)
Fundo.BorderSizePixel = 0
Fundo.Parent = Intro

local TrevoAtivo = true

task.spawn(function()
    while TrevoAtivo and Intro.Parent do
        local s = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        s.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        s.Text = "🍀"
        s.TextSize = math.random(18,32)
        s.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40,40)
        s.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(),0,0,-50)
        s.Parent = Fundo

        local duracao = math.random(4,8)

        TweenService:Create(s, TweenInfo.new(duracao, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            Position = UDim2.new(s.Position.X.Scale,0,1,50),
            TextTransparency = 0.5
        }):Play()

        task.delay(duracao,function()
            if s.Parent then s:Destroy() end
        end)

        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end)

local function Texto(parent, texto, tamanho, pos, altura)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,altura or 30)
    t.Position = pos
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = texto
    t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    t.TextSize = tamanho
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    t.Parent = parent
    return t
end

Texto(Fundo,"BRAZILIAN MECHANICS",25,UDim2.new(0,0,0.23,0),55)
Texto(Fundo,"Brasil Brabo 🍀",13,UDim2.new(0,0,0.23,48),25)

local Caixa = Instance.new("Frame")
Caixa.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280,120)
Caixa.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-140,0.5,-60)
Caixa.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,26,20)
Caixa.Parent = Fundo
Instance.new("UICorner",Caixa).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)

local Borda = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Borda.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,160,70)
Borda.Thickness = 1.5
Borda.Parent = Caixa

local Carregando = Texto(Caixa,"CARREGANDO...",13,UDim2.new(0,0,0,10),25)

local BarBG = Instance.new("Frame")
BarBG.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,12)
BarBG.Position = UDim2.new(0,15,0,42)
BarBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,48,40)
BarBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
BarBG.ClipsDescendants = true
BarBG.Parent = Caixa
Instance.new("UICorner",BarBG).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

local BarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
BarFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
BarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,160,70)
BarFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
BarFill.Parent = BarBG
Instance.new("UICorner",BarFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

local FillStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
FillStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
FillStroke.Thickness = 1.5
FillStroke.Parent = BarFill

local Porcentagem = Texto(Caixa,"0%",11,UDim2.new(0,0,0,62),20)
Porcentagem.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)

task.spawn(function()
    while TrevoAtivo and BarFill.Parent do
        TweenService:Create(FillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {
            Transparency = 0.6
        }):Play()

        task.wait(0.6)
        if not BarFill.Parent then break end

        TweenService:Create(FillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.6), {
            Transparency = 0
        }):Play()

        task.wait(0.6)
    end
end)

local function AnimacaoCarregamento()
    local duracaoTotal = 2.2
    local passos = 40
    local intervalo = duracaoTotal / passos

    for i = 1, passos do
        if not Intro.Parent then return end

        local progresso = i / passos
        local pct = math.floor(progresso * 100)

        TweenService:Create(BarFill, TweenInfo.new(intervalo, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(progresso, 1)
        }):Play()

        Porcentagem.Text = pct.."%"

        if pct >= 90 then
            Porcentagem.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
        elseif pct >= 50 then
            Porcentagem.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80)
        else
            Porcentagem.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
        end

        task.wait(intervalo)
    end

    if not Intro.Parent then return end

    Carregando.Text = "VENENO INJETADO! 🍀"
    Carregando.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
    Porcentagem.Text = "100%"

    TweenService:Create(BarFill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80)
    }):Play()

    FillStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,240,120)

    local escala = Instance.new("UIScale")
    escala.Scale = 1
    escala.Parent = Caixa

    TweenService:Create(escala, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {
        Scale = 1.08
    }):Play()

    task.wait(0.15)

    TweenService:Create(escala, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
        Scale = 1
    }):Play()

    task.wait(0.6)
end

AnimacaoCarregamento()

TrevoAtivo = false
Intro:Destroy()

--========================================================
-- INTERFACE PRINCIPAL
--========================================================
local SG = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SG.Name = "BrasilGui"
SG.ResetOnSpawn = false
SG.Parent = PG

local IsFarming = false
local VelocidadeAlvoKMH = 300

local Carro
local Primary
local ForcasCriadas = {}

local BtnF, Panel, BtnFarm, Status, SpeedGui
local BoxMult

local function CriarUICorner(obj, raio)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,raio or 7)
    c.Parent = obj
end

local function CriarTexto(parent, texto, pos, tamanho)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,0,20)
    t.Position = pos
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = texto
    t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
    t.TextSize = tamanho or 11
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    t.Parent = parent
    return t
end

local function CriarCampo(parent, valor, pos, largura)
    local b = Instance.new("TextBox")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(largura or 1,-16,0,27)
    b.Position = pos
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,48,40)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.TextSize = 12
    b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    b.Text = tostring(valor)
    b.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    b.Parent = parent
    CriarUICorner(b,6)
    return b
end

local function CriarBotao(parent, texto, pos, cor, tamanho)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = tamanho or UDim2.new(1,-16,0,30)
    b.Position = pos
    b.BackgroundColor3 = cor
    b.Text = texto
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.TextSize = 11
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.Parent = parent
    CriarUICorner(b,7)
    return b
end

--========================================================
-- LÓGICA DO CARRO
--========================================================
local function AcharCarro()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return nil end

    if hum and hum.SeatPart then
        local model = hum.SeatPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model and model ~= char then return model end
    end

    local menorDist = 20
    local melhor

    for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= char then
            local seat = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("VehicleSeat",true)
                or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat",true)

            if seat then
                local part = obj.PrimaryPart
                    or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)

                if part then
                    local dist = (hrp.Position-part.Position).Magnitude

                    if dist < menorDist then
                        menorDist = dist
                        melhor = obj
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return melhor
end

local function LimparForcas()
    for _,obj in ipairs(ForcasCriadas) do
        if obj and obj.Parent then obj:Destroy() end
    end

    table.clear(ForcasCriadas)
end

local function Parar()
    IsFarming = false
    LimparForcas()
    Carro = nil
    Primary = nil

    if BtnFarm then
        BtnFarm.Text = "INJETAR VENENO"
        BtnFarm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,48,40)
    end

    if Status then
        Status.Text = "Motor normal."
        Status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
    end
end

local function Iniciar()
    Carro = AcharCarro()

    if not Carro then
        return false,"ERRO: Entre no carro!"
    end

    Primary = Carro.PrimaryPart
        or Carro:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)

    if not Primary then
        return false,"Veículo sem peça principal."
    end

    LimparForcas()

    local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att.Name = "BrasilAttachment"
    att.Parent = Primary

    local vf = Instance.new("VectorForce")
    vf.Name = "BrasilImpulse"
    vf.Attachment0 = att
    vf.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    vf.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
    vf.Force = Vector3.zero
    vf.Parent = Primary

    table.insert(ForcasCriadas,att)
    table.insert(ForcasCriadas,vf)

    IsFarming = true

    return true,"VENENO INJETADO! 🍀"
end

--========================================================
-- FÍSICA DO MOTOR
--========================================================
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not IsFarming or not Carro or not Primary then return end

    if not Carro.Parent or not Primary.Parent then
        Parar()
        return
    end

    local vf = Primary:FindFirstChild("BrasilImpulse")

    if not vf then
        Parar()
        return
    end

    local direcao = Primary.CFrame.LookVector
    local alvo = VelocidadeAlvoKMH / 3.6
    local atual = Primary.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(direcao)
    local diferenca = alvo-atual

    if diferenca > 0 then
        local aceleracao = math.clamp(diferenca*8,0,500)
        vf.Force = direcao*Primary.AssemblyMass*aceleracao
    else
        vf.Force = Vector3.zero
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- VELOCÍMETRO
--========================================================
SpeedGui = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SpeedGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110,32)
SpeedGui.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-55,0.5,30)
SpeedGui.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15,20,15)
SpeedGui.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
SpeedGui.Text = "0 KM/H"
SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
SpeedGui.TextSize = 17
SpeedGui.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SpeedGui.Parent = SG

CriarUICorner(SpeedGui,8)

local SpeedStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
SpeedStroke.Parent = SpeedGui

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local speed = 0

    if Primary and Primary.Parent then
        speed = math.floor(
            (Primary.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * 3.6)
            / DIVISOR_VELOCIMETRO
        )
    end

    SpeedGui.Text = speed.." KM/H"

    if speed > 250 then
        SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80)
        SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80)
    elseif speed > 100 then
        SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
        SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
    else
        SpeedGui.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
        SpeedStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,140)
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- BOTÃO FLUTUANTE E PAINEL COMPACTO
--========================================================
BtnF = CriarBotao(
    SG,
    "🍀",
    UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0),
    Color3.fromRGB(20,60,35),
    UDim2.fromOffset(44,44)
)

BtnF.TextSize = 22
BtnF.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
CriarUICorner(BtnF,30)

local BtnScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
BtnScale.Scale = 1
BtnScale.Parent = BtnF

Panel = Instance.new("Frame")
Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200,195)
Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,30,0.5,-95)
Panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,28,22)

local function AtualizarVelocidade(n)
    n = math.clamp(
        math.floor((n+50)/100)*100,
        100,
        LIMITE_VELOCIDADE
    )

    VelocidadeAlvoKMH = n
    BoxMult.Text = tostring(n)
    Status.Text = "Alvo: "..n.." KM/H"

--========================================================
-- CONTROLE DO MOTOR

BtnFarm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not IsFarming then
        local sucesso,msg = Iniciar()

        if sucesso then
            BtnFarm.Text = "PARAR MOTOR"
            BtnFarm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150,110,0)
            Status.Text = msg
        else
            Status.Text = msg
        end
    else
        Parar()
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- ARRASTAR INTERFACE
--========================================================
local function Drag(obj, alvo)
    alvo = alvo or obj

    local ativo = false
    local inicio
    local posicao

    obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            ativo = true
            inicio = input.Position
            posicao = alvo.Position
        end
    end)

    obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            ativo = false
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if ativo then
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                local delta = input.Position - inicio

                alvo.Position = UDim2.new(
                    posicao.X.Scale,
                    posicao.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    posicao.Y.Scale,
                    posicao.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end
    end)
end

Drag(BtnF,BtnF)
Drag(SpeedGui,SpeedGui)

-- TOGGLE COM ANIMAÇÃO
--========================================================
local PanelAberto = false

local function PulsarBotao()
    BtnScale.Scale = 1

    TweenService:Create(
        BtnScale,
        TweenInfo.new(0.1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Scale = 0.75}
    ):Play()

    task.delay(0.1,function()
        TweenService:Create(
            BtnScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.28,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale = 1}
        ):Play()
    end)
end

BtnF.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    PulsarBotao()

    if PanelAberto then
        PanelAberto = false

        local tweenFechar = TweenService:Create(
            PanelScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.2,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.In),
            {Scale = 0.2}
        )

        tweenFechar:Play()

        tweenFechar.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not PanelAberto then
                Panel.Visible = false
            end
        end)
    else
        PanelAberto = true

        Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
            BtnF.Position.X.Scale,
            BtnF.Position.X.Offset + 32,
            BtnF.Position.Y.Scale,
            BtnF.Position.Y.Offset - 22
        )

        PanelScale.Scale = 0.2
        Panel.Visible = true

        TweenService:Create(
            PanelScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale = 1}
        ):Play()
    end
end)

        bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 1, 4)
        bar.Position = UDim2.new(b / (barCount + 1), -1, -1.2, 0)

        for step = 1, 16 do
            local alpha = step / 16
            local ease = 1 - ((1 - alpha) ^ 3)
            for b = 1, barCount do
                local delayFactor = math.clamp((alpha * 1.35) - ((b - 1) * 0.025), 0, 1)
                local barEase = 1 - ((1 - delayFactor) ^ 3)
                vBars[b].Position = UDim2.new(b / (barCount + 1), -1, -1.2 + (1.2 * barEase), -2)
            end
            hBarTop.Position = UDim2.new(-1 + ease, 0, 0, 4)
            hBarBottom.Position = UDim2.new(1 - ease, 0, 1, -7)
            task.wait(0.016)
        end

            local offset = (shake % 2 == 0) and 2 or -2
            cageContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, offset, 0, 0)
            task.wait(0.025)
        end
        cageContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)

        local tickCount = 0
        while ScreenGui and ScreenGui.Parent do

            local activeIdx = (tickCount % barCount) + 1

        end
    end)

local b96chars = "\t !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~"
local depNames = {"game", "workspace", "Instance", "task", "Enum", "Color3", "UDim2", "Vector3", "CFrame", "math", "string", "table"}

local ssub, schar, sbyte, sfind, sformat, smatch, sgmatch, sgsub, srep = string.sub, string.char, string.byte, string.find, string.format, string.match, string.gmatch, string.gsub, string.rep
local mfloor, mrandom, mmax = math.floor, math.random, math.max
local tconcat, tinsert = table.concat, table.insert

local function wrapLongBracket(str)
    local maxEq = 0
    for eqs in sgmatch(str, "%](=*)") do
        if #eqs >= maxEq then
            maxEq = #eqs + 1
        end
    end
    for eqs in sgmatch(str, "%[(=*)%[") do
        if #eqs >= maxEq then
            maxEq = #eqs + 1
        end
    end
    if maxEq < 1 then
        maxEq = 1
    end
    local eq = srep("=", maxEq)
    return "[" .. eq .. "[" .. str .. "]" .. eq .. "]"
end

local function shuffledIndices(count)
    local list = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        list[i] = i
    end
    for i = count, 2, -1 do
        local j = mrandom(1, i)
        list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
    end
    return list
end

local function randomIdent(prefix)
    return sformat("_%s%x", prefix, mrandom(0x10, 0xff))
end

local function shuffleAlphabet(seed)
    local chars = {}
    for i = 1, #b96chars do
        chars[i] = ssub(b96chars, i, i)
    end
    local state = seed
    for i = #chars, 2, -1 do
        state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648
        local j = (state % i) + 1
        chars[i], chars[j] = chars[j], chars[i]
    end
    return tconcat(chars)
end

local function compressLZW_Base96(str, alphabet)
    local alphaChars = {}
    for i = 1, 96 do
        alphaChars[i] = ssub(alphabet, i, i)
    end

    local function createInitDict()
        local dict = {}
        for i = 0, 255 do
            dict[schar(i)] = i
        end
        return dict, 257
    end

    local dict, dictSize = createInitDict()
    local bitWidth = 9
    local bitBuf = 0
    local bitCount = 0
    local res = {}
    local resLen = 0

    local function pushBits(val, width)
        bitBuf = bitBuf + val * (2 ^ bitCount)
        bitCount = bitCount + width
        while bitCount >= 13 do
            local chunk = bitBuf % 8192
            bitBuf = mfloor(bitBuf / 8192)
            bitCount = bitCount - 13
            local c1 = mfloor(chunk / 96) + 1
            local c2 = (chunk % 96) + 1
            resLen = resLen + 1
            res[resLen] = alphaChars[c1] .. alphaChars[c2]
        end
    end

    local w = ""
    for i = 1, #str do
        local c = ssub(str, i, i)
        local wc = w .. c
        if dict[wc] then
            w = wc
        else
            pushBits(dict[w], bitWidth)
            dict[wc] = dictSize
            dictSize = dictSize + 1
            if dictSize >= 8192 then
                dict, dictSize = createInitDict()
                bitWidth = 9
            elseif dictSize > (2 ^ bitWidth) then
                bitWidth = bitWidth + 1
            end
            w = c
        end
    end

    if w ~= "" then
        pushBits(dict[w], bitWidth)
        dictSize = dictSize + 1
        if dictSize >= 8192 then
            bitWidth = 9
        elseif dictSize > (2 ^ bitWidth) then
            bitWidth = bitWidth + 1
        end
    end
    pushBits(256, bitWidth)

    if bitCount > 0 then
        local chunk = bitBuf % 8192
        local c1 = mfloor(chunk / 96) + 1
        local c2 = (chunk % 96) + 1
        resLen = resLen + 1
        res[resLen] = alphaChars[c1] .. alphaChars[c2]
    end

    return tconcat(res)
end

local function computeState(encoded, alphabet, initState)
    local seen = {}
    local st = initState or 0
    for i = 1, #encoded do
        local ch = ssub(encoded, i, i)
        if not seen[ch] then
            local pos = sfind(alphabet, ch, 1, true)
            if pos then
                st = (st + pos) % 65521
                seen[ch] = true
            end
        end
    end
    return st
end

local function buildEncodedCompilerBytes(seed)
    local shift = (seed % 31) + 7
    local target = "loadstring"
    local bytes = {}
    for i = 1, #target do
        bytes[i] = tostring(sbyte(target, i) + shift)
    end
    return "{" .. tconcat(bytes, ",") .. "}"
end

local function minifyAndLiftConstants(src)
    local out = {}
    local outLen = 0
    local constants = {}
    local constMap = {}
    local lastSigChar = ""
    local i = 1
    local n = #src

    local function emit(s)
        outLen = outLen + 1
        out[outLen] = s
    end

    local function isWordChar(c)
        return c ~= "" and smatch(c, "[A-Za-z0-9_]") ~= nil
    end

    local function registerConst(typeTag, rawLiteral)
        local key = typeTag .. ":" .. rawLiteral
        local id = constMap[key]
        if not id then
            id = #constants + 1
            constants[id] = rawLiteral
            constMap[key] = id
        end
        return "\1K" .. tostring(id) .. "\2"
    end

    while i <= n do
        local ch = ssub(src, i, i)
        local two = ssub(src, i, i + 1)

        if two == "--" then
            local eqs = smatch(src, "^%-%-%[(=*)%[", i)
            if eqs then
                local closePat = "]" .. eqs .. "]"
                local _, endPos = sfind(src, closePat, i + 4 + #eqs, true)
                if endPos then
                    i = endPos + 1
                else
                    break
                end
            else
                local nl = sfind(src, "\n", i, true)
                if nl then
                    if lastSigChar ~= "" and lastSigChar ~= "\n" and lastSigChar ~= ";" then
                        emit("\n")
                        lastSigChar = "\n"
                    end
                    i = nl + 1
                else
                    break
                end
            end
        elseif ch == "\r" then
            i = i + 1
        elseif ch == "\n" or ch == ";" then
            if lastSigChar ~= "" and lastSigChar ~= "\n" and lastSigChar ~= ";" then
                emit(ch)
                lastSigChar = ch
            end
            i = i + 1
        elseif ch == " " or ch == "\t" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local ws = ssub(src, j, j)
                if ws == " " or ws == "\t" then
                    j = j + 1
                else
                    break
                end
            end
            local nextCh = ssub(src, j, j)
            if isWordChar(lastSigChar) and isWordChar(nextCh) then
                emit(" ")
                lastSigChar = " "
            elseif lastSigChar == "." and smatch(nextCh, "[0-9%.]") then
                emit(" ")
                lastSigChar = " "
            elseif lastSigChar == "-" and nextCh == "-" then
                emit(" ")
                lastSigChar = " "
            end
            i = j
        elseif ch == "[" then
            local eqs = smatch(src, "^%[(=*)%[", i)
            if eqs then
                local closePat = "]" .. eqs .. "]"
                local _, endPos = sfind(src, closePat, i + 2 + #eqs, true)
                if endPos then
                    emit(ssub(src, i, endPos))
                    lastSigChar = "]"
                    i = endPos + 1
                else
                    emit(ch)
                    lastSigChar = ch
                    i = i + 1
                end
            else
                emit(ch)
                lastSigChar = ch
                i = i + 1
            end
        elseif ch == '"' or ch == "'" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local c = ssub(src, j, j)
                if c == "\\" then
                    j = j + 2
                elseif c == ch then
                    break
                else
                    j = j + 1
                end
            end
            local rawLit = ssub(src, i, j)
            if isWordChar(lastSigChar) then
                emit(" ")
            end
            emit(registerConst("S", rawLit))
            lastSigChar = ")"
            i = j + 1
        elseif ch == "`" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local c = ssub(src, j, j)
                if c == "\\" then
                    j = j + 2
                elseif c == "`" then
                    break
                else
                    j = j + 1
                end
            end
            emit(ssub(src, i, j))
            lastSigChar = "`"
            i = j + 1
        elseif ssub(src, i, i + 2) == "..." then
            emit("...")
            lastSigChar = "."
            i = i + 3
        elseif two == ".." then
            emit("..")
            lastSigChar = "."
            i = i + 2
        elseif smatch(ch, "[0-9]") or (ch == "." and smatch(src, "^%.[0-9]", i)) then
            local numLit = smatch(src, "^0[xX][0-9a-fA-F_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^0[bB][01_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*%.[0-9_]+[eE][+-]?[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*[eE][+-]?[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*%.[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^%.[0-9_]+[eE][+-]?[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^%.[0-9_]+", i)
                or smatch(src, "^[0-9][0-9_]*", i)
            if numLit then
                if isWordChar(lastSigChar) then
                    emit(" ")
                end
                emit(registerConst("N", numLit))
                lastSigChar = ")"
                i = i + #numLit
            else
                emit(ch)
                lastSigChar = ch
                i = i + 1
            end
        elseif smatch(ch, "[A-Za-z_]") then
            local word = smatch(src, "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", i)
            if (word == "true" or word == "false") and lastSigChar ~= "." and lastSigChar ~= ":" then
                if isWordChar(lastSigChar) then
                    emit(" ")
                end
                emit(registerConst("B", word))
                lastSigChar = ")"
            else
                emit(word)
                lastSigChar = ssub(word, -1, -1)
            end
            i = i + #word
        else
            emit(ch)
            lastSigChar = ch
            i = i + 1
        end
    end

    return tconcat(out), constants
end

local function splitTopLevelCode(src)
    local segments = {}
    local current = {}
    local blockDepth = 0
    local parenDepth = 0
    local inLoopHeader = false
    local hasTopLocalVar = false
    local i = 1
    local n = #src

    while i <= n do
        local ch = ssub(src, i, i)

        if ch == "[" then
            local eqs = smatch(src, "^%[(=*)%[", i)
            if eqs then
                local closePat = "]" .. eqs .. "]"
                local _, endPos = sfind(src, closePat, i + 2 + #eqs, true)
                if endPos then
                    tinsert(current, ssub(src, i, endPos))
                    i = endPos + 1
                else
                    tinsert(current, ch)
                    i = i + 1
                end
            else
                parenDepth = parenDepth + 1
                tinsert(current, ch)
                i = i + 1
            end
        elseif ch == '"' or ch == "'" or ch == "`" then
            local j = i + 1
            while j <= n do
                local c = ssub(src, j, j)
                if c == "\\" then
                    j = j + 2
                elseif c == ch then
                    break
                else
                    j = j + 1
                end
            end
            tinsert(current, ssub(src, i, j))
            i = j + 1
        elseif ch == "(" or ch == "{" then
            parenDepth = parenDepth + 1
            tinsert(current, ch)
            i = i + 1
        elseif ch == ")" or ch == "}" or ch == "]" then
            parenDepth = mmax(0, parenDepth - 1)
            tinsert(current, ch)
            i = i + 1
        elseif smatch(ch, "[A-Za-z_]") then
            local word = smatch(src, "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*", i)
            local nextIdx = i + #word
            if parenDepth == 0 then
                if word == "local" and blockDepth == 0 then
                    hasTopLocalVar = true
                elseif word == "for" or word == "while" then
                    blockDepth = blockDepth + 1
                    inLoopHeader = true
                elseif word == "do" then
                    if inLoopHeader then
                        inLoopHeader = false
                    else
                        blockDepth = blockDepth + 1
                    end
                elseif word == "if" or word == "function" or word == "repeat" then
                    blockDepth = blockDepth + 1
                elseif word == "end" or word == "until" then
                    blockDepth = mmax(0, blockDepth - 1)
                end
            end
            if word ~= "" then
                tinsert(current, word)
            end
            i = nextIdx
        elseif (ch == "\n" or ch == ";") and blockDepth == 0 and parenDepth == 0 then
            tinsert(current, ch)
            local chunkStr = tconcat(current)
            if not hasTopLocalVar and #sgsub(chunkStr, "%s+", "") > 24 then
                tinsert(segments, chunkStr)
                current = {}
            end
            i = i + 1
        else
            tinsert(current, ch)
            i = i + 1
        end
    end

    local tail = tconcat(current)
    if #sgsub(tail, "%s+", "") > 0 then
        if hasTopLocalVar and #segments > 0 then
            segments[#segments] = segments[#segments] .. "\n" .. tail
        else
            tinsert(segments, tail)
        end
    end

    if #segments == 0 then
        segments[1] = src
    end

    return segments
end

local function compilePayloadFromSource(input)
    local seed = mrandom(100000, 999999) + (mfloor((os.clock() % 1) * 100000) % 99999)
    local compilerBytes = buildEncodedCompilerBytes(seed)

    local busVar = randomIdent("b")
    local gateVar = randomIdent("g")

    local gateOrder = shuffledIndices(12)
    local busOrder = shuffledIndices(12)
    local assignOrder = shuffledIndices(12)
    local declOrder = shuffledIndices(12)

    local constSalt = (seed % 7919) + 9500

    local runtimeDepList = {}
    local depToBusSlot = {}
    for g = 1, 12 do
        local depIdx = gateOrder[g]
        runtimeDepList[g] = "e." .. depNames[depIdx]
        depToBusSlot[depIdx] = busOrder[g]
    end
    local runtimeDepsLiteral = "{" .. tconcat(runtimeDepList, ",") .. "}"

    local initStmts = {}
    for idx = 1, 12 do
        local g = assignOrder[idx]
        initStmts[idx] = sformat("%s[%d]=%s(%d)", busVar, busOrder[g], gateVar, g)
    end

    local declNames = {}
    local declCalls = {}
    for idx = 1, 12 do
        local depIdx = declOrder[idx]
        declNames[idx] = depNames[depIdx]
        declCalls[idx] = sformat("%s(%d)", busVar, constSalt - depToBusSlot[depIdx])
    end
    local depDecl = sformat("local %s=%s;", tconcat(declNames, ","), tconcat(declCalls, ","))

    local cleanCode, liftedConstants = minifyAndLiftConstants(input)
    local numConsts = #liftedConstants
    local constChunk

    if numConsts > 0 then
        local slotPool = {}
        local curSlot = mrandom(35, 180)
        for idx = 1, numConsts do
            curSlot = curSlot + mrandom(1, 9)
            slotPool[idx] = curSlot
        end
        local slotPerm = shuffledIndices(numConsts)
        local origToSlot = {}
        for idx = 1, numConsts do
            origToSlot[idx] = slotPool[slotPerm[idx]]
        end

        cleanCode = sgsub(cleanCode, "\1K(%d+)\2", function(idStr)
            local origId = tonumber(idStr)
            local encodedIdx = constSalt - origToSlot[origId]
            return sformat("%s(%d)", busVar, encodedIdx)
        end)

        local writePerm = shuffledIndices(numConsts)
        local constStmts = {}
        for idx = 1, numConsts do
            local origId = writePerm[idx]
            constStmts[idx] = sformat("%s[%d]=%s", busVar, origToSlot[origId], liftedConstants[origId])
        end
        constChunk = sformat("local %s=%s;%s", busVar, busVar, tconcat(constStmts, ";"))
    else
        constChunk = sformat("local %s=%s", busVar, busVar)
    end

    local codeSegments = splitTopLevelCode(cleanCode)

    local rawChunks = {}
    rawChunks[1] = sformat("local %s,%s=%s,%s;%s", busVar, gateVar, busVar, gateVar, tconcat(initStmts, ";"))
    rawChunks[2] = constChunk

    local headerPrefix = sformat("local %s=%s;%s", busVar, busVar, depDecl)

    for idx = 1, #codeSegments do
        rawChunks[2 + idx] = headerPrefix .. "\n" .. codeSegments[idx]
    end

    local serializedSegs = {}
    local runningState = seed % 65521
    for idx = 1, #rawChunks do
        local segSeed = seed + (idx * 7919)
        local segAlpha = shuffleAlphabet(segSeed)
        local segEncoded = compressLZW_Base96(rawChunks[idx], segAlpha)
        runningState = computeState(segEncoded, segAlpha, runningState)
        serializedSegs[idx] = sformat("{%s,%d,%s}", wrapLongBracket(segEncoded), runningState, wrapLongBracket(segAlpha))
    end

    local segTableLiteral = "{" .. tconcat(serializedSegs, ",") .. "}"

local function displayToOutputBox(payload)
    lastOutput = payload
    local byteLen = #payload
    sizeLabel.Text = string.format("%d bytes", byteLen)
    if byteLen > 199999 then
        outputBox.Text = string.format(
            "WARNING: output exceeding maximum roblox capabilites to show text on textbox, to copy your output, click 'copy' button, your output size is : %d byte",
            byteLen
        )
    else
        outputBox.Text = payload
    end
end

local function readSourceFromFile(fileName)
    if fileName == "" then
        return nil, fileName
    end
    if type(isfile) == "function" then
        local existsOk, exists = pcall(isfile, fileName)
        if not existsOk or not exists then
            return nil, fileName
        end
    end
    local loadOk, loadedFn = pcall(loadfile, fileName)
    if not loadOk or type(loadedFn) ~= "function" then
        return nil, fileName
    end
    if type(readfile) == "function" then
        local readOk, content = pcall(readfile, fileName)
        if readOk and type(content) == "string" then
            return content, nil
        end
    end
    return nil, fileName
end

encodeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local sourceText = ""

    if hasFileApis and useFileInput then
        local targetInFile = string.match(inputFileBox.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local loadedSource, missingName = readSourceFromFile(targetInFile)
        if not loadedSource then
            lastOutput = ""
            sizeLabel.Text = "0 bytes"
            outputBox.Text = string.format("Theres no file with name '%s'", missingName or targetInFile)
            statusLabel.Text = "File not found"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 95, 95)
            return
        end
        sourceText = loadedSource
    else
        sourceText = inputBox.Text
    end

    if sourceText == "" or #sourceText < 2 then
        encodeButton.Text = "Script too short!"
        statusLabel.Text = "Invalid input"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 140, 80)
        task.delay(1.2, function()
            if encodeButton and encodeButton.Parent then
                encodeButton.Text = "Encode"
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    encodeButton.Text = "Compressing..."
    statusLabel.Text = "Processing..."
    statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 195, 75)
    task.wait()

    local ok, resultOrErr = pcall(compilePayloadFromSource, sourceText)
    if not ok then
        statusLabel.Text = "Compression error"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 95, 95)
        outputBox.Text = tostring(resultOrErr)
        encodeButton.Text = "Encode"
        return
    end

    local finalPayload = resultOrErr
    lastOutput = finalPayload
    sizeLabel.Text = string.format("%d bytes", #finalPayload)

    if hasFileApis and exportOutputToFile then
        local targetOutFile = string.match(outputFileBox.Text, "^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if targetOutFile == "" then
            targetOutFile = "compressed_output.lua"
        end
        local writeOk, writeErr = pcall(writefile, targetOutFile, finalPayload)
        if writeOk then
            if useFileInput then
                statusLabel.Text = "E2E Exported -> " .. targetOutFile
            else
                statusLabel.Text = "Exported -> " .. targetOutFile
            end
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 210, 120)
        else
            statusLabel.Text = "Writefile failed"
            statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 95, 95)
            outputBox.Text = tostring(writeErr)
        end
    else
        displayToOutputBox(finalPayload)
        statusLabel.Text = "Compressed successfully"
        statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 210, 120)
    end

    encodeButton.Text = "Encode"
end)

}

local function melee(tool)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
    if styles[tool.Name:lower()] then return true end
    local category = tostring(tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType") or tool.ToolTip or ""):lower()
    return category == "melee" or category == "fighting style"
end

local function equipMelee()
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or melee(character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")) then return end

    local bag = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not bag then return end
    local choice
    for _, tool in ipairs(bag:GetChildren()) do
        if melee(tool) then
            choice = tool
            if tool.Name:lower() == "combat" then break end
        end
    end
    if choice then humanoid:EquipTool(choice) end
end

local function characterRoot()
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then return root end
end

local function attack(mob)
    local root = characterRoot()
    local tool = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not root or not mob or not tool or not melee(tool) then return end
    if not registerAttack or not registerHit then return end

    local hits, primary, closest = {}, nil, math.huge
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy.Name == mob.Name and enemy:IsA("Model") then
            local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local targetRoot = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and targetRoot then
                local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= range then
                    if distance < closest then
                        closest = distance
                        primary = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head") or targetRoot
                    end
                    for _, part in ipairs(enemy:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            hits[#hits + 1] = {enemy, part}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if primary then
        pcall(function()
            registerAttack:FireServer(0.0001)
            registerHit:FireServer(primary, hits)
        end)
    end
end

local function level()
    local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
    local value = data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
    return value and value.Value or 1
end

local function currentQuest()
    local currentLevel = level()
    for _, quest in ipairs(quests[sea]) do
        if currentLevel >= quest.min and currentLevel <= quest.max then
            return quest
        end
    end
end

local function questShown()
    local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local frame = main and (main:FindFirstChild("Quest") or main:FindFirstChild("Quest", true))
    if not frame or not frame:IsA("GuiObject") or not frame.Visible then return false end
    local parent = frame.Parent
    while parent and parent ~= main do
        if parent:IsA("GuiObject") and not parent.Visible then return false end
        parent = parent.Parent
    end
    return true
end

local questMissingSince
local lastQuestAttempt = -math.huge
local function startQuest(quest)
    if questShown() then
        questMissingSince = nil
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if not questMissingSince then
        questMissingSince = now
        return
    end
    if now - questMissingSince < 2 or now - lastQuestAttempt < 5 then return end

    lastQuestAttempt = now
    pcall(function()
        comm:InvokeServer("StartQuest", quest.id, quest.index)
    end)
end

local function findMob(name)
    local root = characterRoot()
    if not root then return end
    local closest, target, prefix = math.huge, nil, name .. " ["
    for _, mob in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if mob.Name == name or mob.Name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            local humanoid = mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoid and part and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < closest then
                    closest, target = distance, mob
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local function moveTo(quest, mob)
    local root = characterRoot()
    if not root then return end

    while running and root.Parent and characterRoot() == root and currentQuest() == quest do
        local targetRoot = mob and mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetHumanoid = mob and mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if mob and (not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0) then break end

        local goal = (targetRoot and targetRoot.Position or quest.position.Position) + offset
        local direction = goal - root.Position
        local distance = direction.Magnitude
        if distance <= 5 then
            if mob then attack(mob) end
            break
        end

        local length = math.min(distance, 50)
        local nextPosition = root.Position + direction.Unit * length
        local tween = tweens:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(length / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(nextPosition)
        })
        local done = false
        local connection = tween.Completed:Connect(function() done = true end)
        tween:Play()

        repeat
            task.wait(0.12)
            if mob then attack(mob) end
        until done or not running or characterRoot() ~= root or currentQuest() ~= quest
            or (mob and (not mob.Parent or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0))

        if not done then tween:Cancel() end
        connection:Disconnect()
        if not running or characterRoot() ~= root then break end
    end
end

--[[
--------------------------------------------------------------------
  FREEDOM — v59 (keyless, Luau / Xeno)
  Improvements over v47:
    - frame-rate independent aim smoothing (no more speed tied to FPS)
    - ESP boxes sized from real head/foot projection, distance in the label
    - real player names instead of model names / asset ids
    - FOV circle drawn on screen, matches the actual lock-on cone
    - sliders for smoothing, FOV and max distance (saved to disk if allowed)
    - dead/ragdoll filter on Humanoid state instead of heuristics-only
    - line of sight raycast excludes the local character and the target itself
    - adaptive scan rate: fast when targets exist, lazy when empty
    - manual fire only. The script never clicks for you.
  v49:
    - bots and NPCs are targeted again, not just real players
    - a dead body is dropped the instant its Humanoid fires Died
    - corpse memory: a body seen dead is skipped for 20 s
  v50:
    - ESP has its own list: everything alive, walls included, no FOV cone, bots included
    - lock-on keeps its FOV cone and line-of-sight rule, separate from the ESP
    - corpses filtered on name, Humanoid state, lost RootPart and death spots
  v51:
    - F7 debug overlay: every model in the map, with the reason it was kept or skipped
    - "dummy" removed from the corpse name filter, it was hiding bots named Dummy
  v52:
    - bots are found three ways: player characters, Humanoids, and head+body rigs with no Humanoid
    - a Humanoid with no RootPart no longer rejects a bot, the rig itself is used
    - corpse clones that copy a dead player's name are refused for 25 s
    - F7 also prints the report to the executor console, and shows the sweep counters
  v53:
    - invisible rigs are dropped: a model whose Head and Torso are transparent is not a target
    - models living inside a corpse/ragdoll/debris folder are dropped as well
    - this is the "it aims at something invisible" case, not a corpse that stays visible
  v54:
    - death spots and dead names are only recorded for real players, bots shared one name and killed each other's targeting
    - a dead name is ignored while several models still answer to it
    - F8 dumps every model in the map: name, class, health, transparency, full path
  v55:
    - the ESP is built from the raw sweep, not from the aim list: no filter can hide a body any more
    - a model with only a head, or only a torso, still gets a box and a distance label
    - bots are judged like bots: only Dead and zero health disqualify them, not Physics or FallingDown
  v56:
    - lock-on on bots: their Humanoid health and state no longer disqualify them, visibility does
    - invisible colliders (glass, triggers) no longer count as cover for line of sight
  v57:
    - lock-on is player-only by request: bot rigs never steal the camera
    - ESP still draws everyone, bots included, through walls
  v58:
    - teammates never take the lock: Roblox Team, then Team attributes, then a name list
    - CFG.Allies holds exact names, CFG.IgnoreAllies switches the whole rule off
    - ESP keeps drawing teammates, it is a box, not a trigger
  v59 - Freedom:
    - tabbed menu: AIM / VISUALS / MISC / CONFIG, sidebar like the desktop build
    - six colour presets cycled by clicking a swatch row, applied live
    - ESP split into box / name / distance / health bar / head dot / snapline
    - health bar shaded green, amber, red on the Humanoid ratio
    - config file renamed freedom.json, old sniper48.json still read once
    - F9 toggles the snapline, F5 ignores the current target
--------------------------------------------------------------------
]]

local function makeSlider(parent, order, text, min, max, get, set, format)
    local r = row(parent, order, 40)

    local name = label(r, text, 12, false)
    name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 2)
    name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16)

    local valueLabel = label(r, "", 11, true, COL.accent)
    valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 2)
    valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 16)
    valueLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

    local track = Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 6)
    track.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 24)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = COL.off
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.Parent = r
    corner(track, 3)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = track
    corner(fill, 3)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = COL.text
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = track
    corner(knob, 6)

    local function paint()
        local v = get()
        local t = (clamp(v, min, max) - min) / math.max(max - min, 0.0001)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
        valueLabel.Text = format and format(v) or tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5))
    end

    local dragging = false
    local function apply(input)
        local origin = track.AbsolutePosition
        local width = math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local t = clamp((input.Position.X - origin.X) / width, 0, 1)
        set(min + (max - min) * t)
        paint()
    end

    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            apply(input)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            apply(input)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            dragging = false
            saveConfig()
        end
    end)

    painters[#painters + 1] = paint
    paint()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GAME HELPERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local DEAD_STATES = {
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead] = true,
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics] = true,
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown] = true,
    [Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding] = true,
}

-- games keep corpses around: as a ragdoll, as a renamed clone, or as a dummy
-- that still reports full health. Those words are the ones they never use for a living body.
-- only names a living body never carries. "dummy" is deliberately absent:
-- plenty of games call their bots Dummy or BotDummy, and that filter was hiding them.
local CORPSE_WORDS = { "ragdoll", "corpse", "deadbody", "dead_body" }

local function looksLikeCorpse(character)
    local lower = string.lower(character.Name or "")
    for _, word in ipairs(CORPSE_WORDS) do
        if string.find(lower, word, 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- a corpse clone keeps the name of the player it came from. Remember it and
-- refuse any model carrying that name, since no living body answers to it.
local deadNames = {}

local function markDeadName(name)
    if name and #name > 0 then deadNames[name] = os.clock() + 25 end
end

local function isDeadName(character)
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then return false end
    local name = character.Name
    if not name then return false end
    local expiry = deadNames[name]
    if not expiry then return false end
    if os.clock() > expiry then
        deadNames[name] = nil
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local HIDDEN_PARTS = { "Head", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }
local CORPSE_CONTAINERS = { "corpse", "ragdoll", "deadbody", "bodies", "debris" }

local function inCorpseContainer(character)
    local node = character.Parent
    local depth = 0
    while node and node ~= Workspace and depth < 6 do
        local name = string.lower(tostring(node.Name))
        for _, word in ipairs(CORPSE_CONTAINERS) do
            if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then return true end
        end
        node = node.Parent
        depth = depth + 1
    end
    return false
end

-- a body the game hides is still a body. Aiming a box at a transparent rig
-- looks exactly like locking onto thin air, which is what players report.
local function isHidden(character)
    local found = false
    for _, partName in ipairs(HIDDEN_PARTS) do
        local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            found = true
            if part.Transparency < 0.85 then return false end
        end
    end
    return found
end

local function hasBodyPart(character)
    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or character.PrimaryPart
end

local function isAlive(character)
    if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
    if looksLikeCorpse(character) then return false end
    if isHidden(character) then return false end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= nil
    if humanoid then
        if isPlayer then
            if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
            if DEAD_STATES[humanoid:GetState()] then return false end
            return hasBodyPart(character) ~= nil
        end
        -- bots: a visible rig with a body part is a target. Their Humanoid is
        -- decoration — plenty sit at zero health or in Physics for their whole life.
        return hasBodyPart(character) ~= nil
    end
    -- no Humanoid at all: some games ship bots as plain rigs, head + body only
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") ~= nil and hasBodyPart(character) ~= nil
end

local function partsOf(character)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not rootPart then
        local primary = character.PrimaryPart
        if primary then rootPart = primary end
    end
    return head, rootPart
end

local function nameOf(character)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if player then return player.DisplayName ~= "" and player.DisplayName or player.Name end
    local name = character.Name or "bot"
    if #name >= 32 and name:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x-") then return "bot" end
    if #name > 20 then return string.sub(name, 1, 18) .. ".." end
    return name
end

-- A teammate must never eat the lock. Roblox teams first, then any Team
-- attribute the game sets, then a hand-written name list in the config.
local function isAlly(character)
    if not CFG.IgnoreAllies then return false end
    local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    if not player then return false end

    if lp.Team ~= nil and player.Team == lp.Team then return true end

    for _, key in ipairs({ "Team", "team", "TeamName", "teamName", "TeamId", "teamId" }) do
        local mine, theirs = lp:GetAttribute(key), player:GetAttribute(key)
        if mine ~= nil and theirs ~= nil and mine == theirs then return true end
        local myBody, theirBody = lp.Character, player.Character
        if myBody and theirBody then
            local mineC, theirsC = myBody:GetAttribute(key), theirBody:GetAttribute(key)
            if mineC ~= nil and theirsC ~= nil and mineC == theirsC then return true end
        end
    end

    for _, name in ipairs(CFG.Allies or {}) do
        local lowered = string.lower(tostring(name))
        if lowered == string.lower(player.Name) then return true end
        if player.DisplayName and lowered == string.lower(player.DisplayName) then return true end
    end

    return false
end

local corpses = {}

local function markCorpse(character, seconds)
    if character then corpses[character] = os.clock() + (seconds or CFG.CorpseHold) end
end

local function isCorpse(character)
    local expiry = corpses[character]
    if not expiry then return false end
    if not character.Parent or os.clock() > expiry then
        corpses[character] = nil
        return false
    end
    return true
end

-- games often spawn a fresh ragdoll model where the body fell. Remember the
-- spot of every death for a few seconds and refuse anything standing there.
local deathSpots = {}

local function markDeathSpot(position)
    if not position then return end
    deathSpots[#deathSpots + 1] = { pos = position, at = os.clock() }
    while #deathSpots > 30 do table.remove(deathSpots, 1) end
end

local function nearDeathSpot(character, rootPart)
    if not rootPart then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    local where = rootPart.Position
    for index = #deathSpots, 1, -1 do
        local spot = deathSpots[index]
        if now - spot.at > 8 then
            table.remove(deathSpots, index)
        elseif (spot.pos - where).Magnitude <= 6 then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function canSee(character, targetPart)
    if not targetPart then return false end
    local ignored = { character }
    if lp.Character then ignored[#ignored + 1] = lp.Character end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, targetPart.Position - origin, rayParams)
    if not result then return true end
    if result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then return true end
    -- invisible colliders are not cover: glass walls and trigger boxes must not
    -- block a line of sight that the eye clearly has
    if result.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and result.Instance.Transparency >= 0.85 then return true end
    return false
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TARGETING
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local State = {
    visible = 0,
    total = 0,
    errors = 0,
    target = nil,
    copyUntil = 0,
    candidates = {},
    espList = {},
    report = {},
    aliveCount = 0,
    lastScan = 0,
    lastSweep = 0,
    characters = {},
    deathHooks = {},
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHARACTER SWEEP (players + bots)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function sweepCharacters()
    local found, seen = {}, {}
    local humanoids, rigs = 0, 0

    for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if other ~= lp then
            local character = other.Character
            if character and character.Parent then
                found[#found + 1] = character
                seen[character] = true
            end
        end
    end

    if CFG.IncludeBots then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            for _, descendant in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("Humanoid") then
                    humanoids = humanoids + 1
                    local model = descendant.Parent
                    if model and not seen[model] and model ~= lp.Character then
                        seen[model] = true
                        found[#found + 1] = model
                    end
                elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name == "Head" then
                    local model = descendant.Parent
                    if model and not seen[model] and model ~= lp.Character
                        and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                             or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) then
                        seen[model] = true
                        rigs = rigs + 1
                        found[#found + 1] = model
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        if not ok then
            State.errors = State.errors + 1
        end
    end

    local nameCount = {}
    for _, model in ipairs(found) do
        local name = model.Name
        nameCount[name] = (nameCount[name] or 0) + 1
    end
    State.nameCount = nameCount
    State.sweepInfo = string.format("sweep %d models (%d humanoid, %d rigs)", #found, humanoids, rigs)
    State.characters = found
    State.lastSweep = os.clock()
    return found
end

-- F8: the whole map, unfiltered. Every model holding a Humanoid or a body part
-- gets one line: name, class, health, transparency, full path. Nothing is judged.
function dumpWorld()
    local seen, rows = {}, {}
    local ok = pcall(function()
        for _, item in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            local candidate = item:IsA("Humanoid")
                or (item:IsA("BasePart") and (item.Name == "Head"
                    or item.Name == "Torso" or item.Name == "UpperTorso"))
            if candidate then
                local model = item.Parent
                if model and not seen[model] then
                    seen[model] = true
                    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    local torso = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                    rows[#rows + 1] = string.format("%s [%s] hp=%s transp=%s/%s path=%s",
                        model.Name,
                        model.ClassName,
                        humanoid and tostring(math.floor(humanoid.Health)) or "-",
                        head and string.format("%.2f", head.Transparency) or "-",
                        torso and string.format("%.2f", torso.Transparency) or "-",
                        model:GetFullName())
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    print(string.format("[freedom] dump %d model(s)%s", #rows, ok and "" or " — scan error"))
    for index = 1, math.min(#rows, 40) do
        print("[freedom] " .. rows[index])
    end
end

local function watchDeath(character)
    if State.deathHooks[character] then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    local ok, connection = pcall(function()
        return humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            State.deathHooks[character] = nil
            markCorpse(character)
            -- only a real player leaves a corpse worth remembering: bots die by the
            -- dozen in the same spot, and their shared names poison every filter
            if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
                markDeadName(character.Name)
                local dyingRoot = humanoid.RootPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                markDeathSpot(dyingRoot and dyingRoot.Position)
            end
            if State.target and State.target.character == character then
                State.target = nil
                State.lastScan = 0
            end
        end)
    end)
    if ok then State.deathHooks[character] = connection end
end

local function scanTargets()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - State.lastSweep >= CFG.BotScan then
        sweepCharacters()
    end

    local list = {}
    local espList = {}
    local report = {}
    local visibleCount = 0
    local totalCount = 0
    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize

    for _, character in ipairs(State.characters) do
        local reason = nil
        local isPlayerModel = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) ~= nil
        local ally = isAlly(character)
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not character.Parent then
            reason = "gone"
        elseif character == lp.Character then
            reason = "self"
        elseif isCorpse(character) then
            reason = "corpse-memory"
        elseif looksLikeCorpse(character) then
            reason = "corpse-name"
        elseif isDeadName(character) and (State.nameCount[character.Name] or 0) <= 1 then
            reason = "corpse-name-match"
        elseif inCorpseContainer(character) then
            reason = "corpse-folder"
        elseif isHidden(character) then
            reason = "invisible"
        elseif not humanoid then
            reason = "no-humanoid"
        elseif humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            reason = "hp0"
        elseif DEAD_STATES[humanoid:GetState()] then
            reason = "state"
        elseif not humanoid.RootPart or not humanoid.RootPart.Parent then
            reason = "no-root"
        end

        if reason then
            report[#report + 1] = string.format("%s  ·  %s", nameOf(character), reason)
        else
            local head, rootPart = partsOf(character)
            if nearDeathSpot(character, rootPart) then
                markCorpse(character, 8)
                report[#report + 1] = string.format("%s  ·  death-spot", nameOf(character))
            else
            totalCount = totalCount + 1
            local aimPart = head or rootPart
            -- lock-on is for real players only, and never for a teammate
            if isPlayerModel and not ally and aimPart and aimPart.Parent then
                local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
                local delta = aimPart.Position - origin
                local distance = delta.Magnitude
                if distance <= CFG.MaxDist then
                    watchDeath(character)
                    -- ESP: everything alive around us, bots included, walls included.
                    -- Only things actually in front of the camera get drawn, nothing behind the head.
                    -- ESP is built separately, from the raw sweep: see below

                    -- Lock-on stays inside the FOV cone and respects line of sight
                    local dir = cam.CFrame.LookVector
                    local unit = delta.Unit
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(clamp(dir:Dot(unit), -1, 1)))
                    if angle <= CFG.Fov then
                        local visible = (not CFG.VisibleOnly) or canSee(character, aimPart)
                        if visible then
                            visibleCount = visibleCount + 1
                            list[#list + 1] = {
                                character = character,
                                head = head,
                                root = rootPart,
                                aim = aimPart,
                                name = nameOf(character),
                                distance = distance,
                                angle = angle,
                                score = angle * 0.7 + (distance / math.max(CFG.MaxDist, 1)) * 30,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            end -- nearDeathSpot guard
        end
    end

    -- ESP: built from the raw sweep, never from the aim list. A body the aim
    -- filters reject still gets a box, which is the whole point of an overlay.
    for _, character in ipairs(State.characters) do
        if character.Parent and character ~= lp.Character and not isCorpse(character) then
            local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local body = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                or character.PrimaryPart
            local anchor = head or body
            if anchor and anchor.Parent then
                local headHidden = (not head) or head.Transparency >= 0.85
                local bodyHidden = (not body) or body.Transparency >= 0.85
                if not (headHidden and bodyHidden) then
                    local distance = (anchor.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance <= CFG.MaxDist then
                        local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(anchor.Position)
                        if onScreen and screen.Z > 0
                            and screen.X > -200 and screen.X < viewport.X + 200
                            and screen.Y > -200 and screen.Y < viewport.Y + 200 then
                            espList[#espList + 1] = {
                                character = character,
                                head = head or body,
                                root = body or head,
                                aim = anchor,
                                name = nameOf(character),
                                distance = distance,
                                score = distance,
                            }
                            report[#report + 1] = string.format("%s  ·  esp %.0fm", nameOf(character), distance / 3.571)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.score < b.score end)
    table.sort(espList, function(a, b) return a.score < b.score end)
    State.candidates = list
    State.espList = espList
    State.report = report
    State.aliveCount = #State.characters
    State.visible = visibleCount
    State.total = totalCount
    State.target = list[1]
    return list[1]
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- AIM
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function aimAt(target, dt)
    if not target or not cam then return end
    local desired = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, target.aim.Position)
    -- exponential smoothing: same feel at 30 fps and at 240 fps
    local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-CFG.Smooth * dt)
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(desired, clamp(alpha, 0, 1))

    if CFG.RotateBody and lp.Character then
        local myRoot = lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myRoot then
            local bodyWant = CFrame.lookAt(myRoot.Position, target.aim.Position)
            local bodyAlpha = 1 - math.exp(-10 * dt)
            myRoot.CFrame = myRoot.CFrame:Lerp(bodyWant, clamp(bodyAlpha, 0, 1))
        end
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESP RENDER
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function renderEsp()
    if not drawingOk then return end
    local used = 0
    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
    local boxColor = palColor(CFG.ColorBox)
    local textColor = palColor(CFG.ColorText)
    local lineColor = palColor(CFG.ColorSnapline)

    for _, entry in ipairs(State.espList) do
        local head = entry.head or entry.aim
        local bodyPart = entry.root or entry.aim or entry.head
        if head and bodyPart then
            local headScreen, headOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
            local footScreen, footOn = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(bodyPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0))
            if headOn and footOn and headScreen.Z > 0 and footScreen.Z > 0 then
                used = used + 1
                if used <= CFG.MaxTargets then
                    local box = boxAt(used)
                    if box then
                        local height = math.abs(footScreen.Y - headScreen.Y)
                        local width = height * 0.5
                        local top = math.min(headScreen.Y, footScreen.Y)
                        local left = headScreen.X - width * 0.5

                        box.square.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                        box.square.Position = Vector2.new(left, top)
                        box.square.Color = boxColor
                        box.square.Filled = CFG.BoxFill
                        box.square.Transparency = CFG.BoxFill and 0.7 or 1
                        box.square.Visible = CFG.Esp

                        -- barre de vie, proportion Humanoid
                        local humanoid = entry.character and entry.character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local health = humanoid and humanoid.Health or 100
                        local maxHealth = math.max(humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth or 100, 1)
                        local ratio = clamp(health / maxHealth, 0, 1)
                        local barX = left - 5
                        box.barBg.Size = Vector2.new(3, height)
                        box.barBg.Position = Vector2.new(barX, top)
                        box.barBg.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspHealth
                        box.barFill.Size = Vector2.new(3, height * ratio)
                        box.barFill.Position = Vector2.new(barX, top + height * (1 - ratio))
                        if ratio > 0.6 then
                            box.barFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(96, 220, 128)
                        elseif ratio > 0.3 then
                            box.barFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 205, 96)
                        else
                            box.barFill.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90)
                        end
                        box.barFill.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspHealth

                        -- point de tete
                        box.headDot.Position = Vector2.new(headScreen.X, headScreen.Y)
                        box.headDot.Color = boxColor
                        box.headDot.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspHeadDot

                        -- ligne depuis le bas de l'ecran
                        box.line.From = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y)
                        box.line.To = Vector2.new(headScreen.X, top)
                        box.line.Color = lineColor
                        box.line.Visible = CFG.Esp and CFG.EspSnapline

                        -- etiquette : nom et/ou distance, chacun son interrupteur
                        local parts = {}
                        if CFG.EspName then parts[#parts + 1] = entry.name end
                        if CFG.EspDist then
                            parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%dm", math.floor(entry.distance / 3.571))
                        end
                        box.text.Text = table.concat(parts, "  ")
                        box.text.Position = Vector2.new(headScreen.X, top - 15)
                        box.text.Color = textColor
                        box.text.Visible = CFG.Esp and #parts > 0
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for index = math.min(used, CFG.MaxTargets) + 1, #boxCache do
        hideBox(index)
    end
end

local function renderFov()
    if not fovCircle then return end
    if not CFG.FovCircle or not CFG.LockOn then
        fovCircle.Visible = false
        return
    end
    local viewport = cam.ViewportSize
    local halfFov = math.rad(cam.FieldOfView * 0.5)
    local radius = (math.tan(math.rad(CFG.Fov)) / math.tan(halfFov)) * (viewport.Y * 0.5)
    fovCircle.Position = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    fovCircle.Radius = math.max(radius, 1)
    fovCircle.Visible = true
end

-- UI REFRESH
--------------------------------------------------------------------
local function refreshUi()
    local target = State.target
    if target then
        targetName.Text = string.sub(target.name, 1, 20)
        targetName.TextColor3 = COL.text
        targetSub.Text = string.format("%.0f m · %.0f°", target.distance / 3.571, target.angle)
        cardStroke.Color = COL.accent

        dot.BackgroundColor3 = COL.accent
    else
        targetName.Text = "none"

        cardStroke.Color = COL.line

    debugBox.Visible = CFG.Debug

        local lines = {
            string.format("models %d · alive %d · esp %d · aim %d · err %d",
                State.aliveCount, State.total, #State.espList, #State.candidates, State.errors or 0),
            State.sweepInfo or "sweep -",

        for index = 1, math.min(#State.report, 12) do

        if os.clock() - (State.lastPrint or 0) > 2.5 then
            State.lastPrint = os.clock()
            print("[freedom] " .. table.concat(lines, " | "))
        end

    if os.clock() < State.copyUntil then

        discordStroke.Transparency = 0.2

        copyBtn.Text = "COPY"
        discordStroke.Color = COL.line
        discordStroke.Transparency = 0.4
    end
end
